name: Zarzal (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and yellow, charged at the centre with a white five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Zarzal, a municipality in the department of Valle del Cauca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as created on 12 March 1946 (Acuerdo n.º 05).
